card.name: Linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, with, of and including that sit right before a specific brand or drug name, especially after reaction or exposure terms in prescribing-information text.

modes.label: Reaction or treatment links
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'with' follows a reaction, exposure or treatment phrase and comes just before a named drug.

modes.label: Lists and dose phrases
modes.description: A comma, 'including' or 'of' comes right before a drug name in an interaction list or dose statement.

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug name is expected, such as 'treated with' or 'exposure to'.
